independent_audit.time_provenance_count_scope: Selected packet and support-link counts each include exact original capture-time and source-locator checks. Fresh candidate first-capture anchors are counted once per family; earlier reported rows add no fresh Hello data/support.

limitations: QUALIFIED_LIMITATIONS is not GOAL_PASS or full decoding; all1825 original raw losses remain explicit.

Prior pages prove artifact consistency only. Prior outcome rows are reported references with no fresh Hello metadata/support and no authenticated execution/acquisition claim.
TCP tuple assignment and matching bytes do not prove persistent physical-device/person identity or compromise. No decryption, endpoint contact, replay, external resolution or enrichment occurs.
Only the owner-confirmed three-classic-PCAP dataset is validated here; no30GB-scale or actual PCAPNG claim.
Original Tetra database and genuine combined-source clock/network calibration remain unavailable; earlier BLE validation retains its original tested revision.
Private paths, source/key/content hashes, evidence/cohort/packet identifiers, exact source times and Hello fields are omitted.
metric_limitations: Producer/auditor snapshots precede terminal serialization; separate complete CLI and GNU Time measurements include finalization and enforce unchanged acceptance budgets.
RSS/scratch samples can miss transient allocations and are measured gates, not OS quotas. No cache flushing is claimed.
Harness reaped-child lifetime HWM may include prior jobs; reported conservative sums do not imply simultaneous maxima.
Selected-record/support checks are comprehensive within each family, not a fresh whole-source hash or new acquisition-authenticity claim.
scope: Two independently executed deterministic continuation families over the same closed ordinary case; all selected whole fitting cohorts audited, with permanent exclusions and indeterminate results retained.
